entities.name: Bardic Circle
entities.description: Section of the Order of the D'Avenant where squires with overactive imaginations are trained as poets.

entities.name: Order of the D'Avenant
entities.description: Order whose squires keep a vigil and may be sent to the Bardic Circle.

entities.name: Avenaise
entities.description: Land whose poetry standard is extremely high and famous.

entities.name: Alais
entities.description: Golden-Shield, subject of the epic "The Death of Alais".

entities.name: Isabeau
entities.description: Strong-Sword-Blade, subject of the "Genealogy of Isabeau".
